items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: It was Tommy Dorsey, he had the Raleigh and Kool Show that was called “The Amateur Swing Contest.” ... And so I auditioned for that and I got on the show.

ctx.x: And it was live of course, right?

Yeah. There were two broadcasts I think, I’m pretty sure, or I think they had tape by those days. You know they had an east coast broadcast and a west coast broadcast. We didn’t talk about the Tommy Dorsey—
No, I was just looking at my notes here.

items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: are you familiar with the Dorsey Brothers record of “Honeysuckle Rose?”

ctx.x: I played “Honeysuckle Rose,” and I remember — are you familiar with the Dorsey Brothers record of “Honeysuckle Rose?”
